name: session_search
description:
Recall past sessions: search them, or read one. Four shapes, by the arguments you give:
- query: find sessions (all terms must match; "quoted phrase", deploy* for a prefix, OR, NOT). The best match comes with the messages around it; the others with the matching line.
- session_id + around_message_id: read the messages around one (scroll with the first or last id you got).
- session_id alone: read a whole session (long ones: beginning and end).
- nothing: the most recent sessions.

Use it when the user refers to earlier work ("what did we decide about X", "where did we leave Y") or when past context would help — before asking them to repeat themselves. It searches conversation history only: when the user points you at a file, a URL or a live system, look there first, and never conclude something does not exist from history alone.

window.description: scroll: messages on each side (default 5, up to 20)

limit.description: query/browse: how many sessions (default 3 for a query, 10 to browse; up to 10)

sort.description: query: prefer recent ("where did we leave X") or early ("how did X start") matches
